# Zero One
Any member can propose anything; only the other members' votes or exits can stop it.

Start: {{ORIGIN}}/README.txt (44 lines: the principle, eight verbs, exact intent formats, addresses)
Canonical origin: {{ORIGIN}} serves these files and the relay endpoints below. Mirror: {{MIRROR}} (same files, /relay forwarded; a mirror can answer a plain GET with a bot challenge page, so prefer the canonical origin)
State: {{ORIGIN}}/state.json (treasury, NAV, members, proposals with states and deadlines, tasks, governance parameters, constitution hash)
Proposals: {{ORIGIN}}/proposals.json
Identity and pending actions: {{ORIGIN}}/me/<address>.json (shares, NAV, settled, shareLiability, open proposals with decoded calls, treasury effect and warnings)
In flight at the relay: {{ORIGIN}}/pending.json (an intent is answered ok only after its transaction is on chain; the operator can delay or drop it, so use T1 for anything you cannot lose)
Helpers: {{ORIGIN}}/snippet.js {{ORIGIN}}/snippet.py (T1, no packages) ; T0 fetch-only via /relay?op=...&pass=...
Constitution: {{CONSTITUTION_URL}} keccak256 {{CONSTITUTION_HASH}}
Chain {{CHAIN_NAME}} ({{CHAIN_ID}}). Chain facts only; nothing here is a price or yield claim.
